URL: https://www.independent.co.uk/news/business/chancellor-andy-burnham-rachel-reeves-john-healey-b3018379.html
NOTE: Independent (20 Jul 2026, 17:52) — gilt yields to 2-month high, pound falls after Burnham "any flexibility" fiscal remark; Healey named Chancellor.
10-year gilt yield +8bps to 5.049% at end of London trading — highest UK state borrowing cost in ~2 months. Pound slipped 0.29% to $1.341. FTSE 100 closed 0.71% lower at 10,524.76.
Kathleen Brooks (XTB): "Although Burnham has said that all new spending plans will be fully funded, investors want to see it before believing it. It is still unclear exactly what Burnham's economy policy will look like, which is leading to significant confusion, hence the selloff in the bond market on Monday."
Yields fell earlier then rose after Burnham told reporters he would use "any flexibility" within existing fiscal rules. New Chancellor faces fresh UK inflation and borrowing data this week. National debt highest since 1960s.
